How to Choose and Hang Unique Office Wall Decor

1. Measure your wall space first: Use a tape measure or hold sheets of paper up to the wall to map out how much space you have. For a row of three prints, allow for the width of all three pieces plus the gaps between them — typically 5–8 cm between each print works well.

2. Pick a colour anchor: Choose prints that share at least one colour with something already in your office — your desk, a plant pot, a cushion on a chair. With the Autumn in New York set, the warm ochre tones anchor beautifully with natural wood desks, sage green accessories or warm white walls.

3. Decide on your arrangement: A straight horizontal row at eye level is the simplest and most effective layout for a set of three. If your wall is taller than it is wide, try a staggered or vertical arrangement instead.

4. Choose your format: Decide whether you want the prints unframed (so you can source your own frame), framed (ready to hang immediately), or on wrapped canvas for a more textured, contemporary feel.

5. Hang and adjust: Use a spirit level to keep things straight. Step back and adjust the gaps until the arrangement feels balanced — small tweaks make a big difference to the finished look.

Choosing Your Format: Office Wall Art Print Options Compared

Unframed Print on Luster Art Paper — A crisp, slightly sheen finish that makes ochre tones and illustrated detail pop under office lighting. You choose and source your own frame. Great if you already have frames or want full control over the finish.

Unframed Print on Museum Quality Paper — The richest, most gallery-like result with deeper colour reproduction and exceptional detail clarity. Also unframed — ideal if you want to display in a high-end frame of your own choosing.

Framed Print — Comes ready to hang straight out of the box — no frame hunting, no measuring, no fuss. Available in multiple sizes with your choice of Luster or Museum quality paper inside. The most convenient option for busy offices.

Wrapped Canvas — The artwork is printed directly onto canvas and stretched over a wooden frame with the image wrapping around the edges. Arrives ready to hang and has a tactile, studio quality that suits contemporary and creative office spaces particularly well. No glass, no frame needed.
